info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Willow Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Willow Notebook Detail Creation API enables businesses to create detailed descriptions for the Willow Notebook product line. This endpoint facilitates the submission of product specifications and features essential for the catalog. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and e-commerce platforms that need to enhance their inventory with rich product details. By using this API, organizations can ensure comprehensive and accurate representation of their Willow Notebook offerings in the marketplace.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit details for a Willow Notebook, enabling personalized entries and customizations specific to each user's needs.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating details of a willow notebook. The payload must include all necessary fields as defined in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details.

CreateCatalogWillowNotebookDetailRequest.title: Willow Notebook Operation Request

willow_notebook_id.description: The unique identifier for the Willow notebook.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The number of notebooks to be operated on.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the operation is of high priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Willow notebook.

CreateCatalogWillowNotebookDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating or updating an operation related to a Willow notebook.

CreateCatalogWillowNotebookDetailRespons.title: Post Notebook Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the record created or modified by the operation.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was processed, in ISO 8601 format.

matchedCount.description: The count of records matched during the operation.

CreateCatalogWillowNotebookDetailRespons.description: Response schema for the successful execution of a notebook operation.

content-type.description: The media type of the resource being returned in the response. This indicates the format of the data provided.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request and generate the response. This can be useful for performance monitoring.
